 Sports Fenerbahce thrash Corum FK 5-0 in Emre Belozoglu's first game in charge
 Mason Greenwood, Irfan Can Kahveci score braces as Yellow Canaries end 2-match losing streak in Turkish Super Lig Halis Sunnetci 09 November 2026 • Update : 09 November 2026 ISTANBUL Fenerbahce secured an emphatic 5-0 away victory over Corum FK on Sunday as new head coach Emre Belozoglu made a winning start to his tenure, with Mason Greenwood and Irfan Can Kahveci each scoring twice in the Turkish Super Lig.
 The Yellow Canaries ended their two-match losing streak in the league, building on Wednesday's UEFA Champions League victory over Liverpool to climb to fifth place in the standings.
 Greenwood opened the scoring in the 12th minute after Oguz Aydin launched a counterattack with a long pass from his own half. The English winger raced into the penalty area before firing a powerful shot into the near corner from a tight angle.
 Irfan Can doubled the visitors' advantage in the 21st minute, marking his 200th appearance for Fenerbahce with a spectacular goal.
 After Ismail Yuksek intercepted the ball in Corum's half, Romelu Lukaku set up the Turkish midfielder, who curled a powerful left-footed effort into the top corner from around 25 yards.
 Fenerbahce went into halftime with a comfortable 2-0 lead.
 Irfan Can completed his brace in the 56th minute after receiving a pass from Matteo Guendouzi near the edge of the penalty area. The Turkish international feinted a left-footed shot before curling a right-footed effort into the top corner to make it 3-0.
 Greenwood added his second goal seven minutes later, finishing first-time into the bottom corner after Levent Mercan delivered a low pass from the left side of the box.
 Oguz Aydin completed the rout with a close-range finish at the far post after substitute Kerem Akturkoglu, released down the left by fellow substitute Vedat Muriqi, sent a low cross into the area.
 The commanding victory marked an impressive start for Belozoglu, who took charge of Fenerbahce following the club's recent struggles in the domestic league.
 The Istanbul side moved up to fifth place with 19 points after 11 matches, while Corum FK remained ninth with 16 points.
